description:
A shared dinner, a trip for four, a flat with roommates — Splitor remembers who paid for what and then tells you the one thing that matters: who owes whom, and how much.

No spreadsheets. No calculator in your notes app.

HOW IT WORKS

— Create a group: a trip, a flat, a weekend with friends.
— Add expenses: who paid, and who it's split between.
— Splitor keeps the balances and nets out mutual debts, so five transfers become one.

WHAT'S INSIDE

— Add an expense by voice. Hold the mic and say who had what and what it cost — Splitor parses it and fills in the form.
— Snap the receipt. Items and prices are read automatically; you just assign them to people.
— Split evenly or by exact amounts. Someone skipped dessert? Give them their own number.
— Group totals. Where the money went this month, who paid most often, the biggest expenses.
— Friends. Every balance across all your shared groups in one list.
— Offline. On the metro, on a plane, abroad with no data — entries are saved and sync themselves when you're back online.
— Per-group currency. Euros, dollars, roubles — each group keeps its own.
— Telegram bot. Same account: invite friends with a link, without making them install anything.

YOUR MONEY STAYS YOURS

Splitor doesn't process payments and never asks for a card. It only works out who owes whom. Send the money however you normally would.

STRAIGHT ANSWERS

The app is free. No ads. Your data isn't sold.

Questions and requests: @split_money_bot on Telegram.

Privacy policy: https://splitor.zagirnur.dev/privacy
